sources.snippet: Project Abstract Queryn is an embedding translation and enrichment engine: given a text chunk and its existing embedding from Model A, it returns the equivalent embedding in Model B's space — without re-embedding the source corpus.

sources.snippet: Adapters — Data Gathering & Architecture Research This document is the deep-dive companion to the Adapters/ section of the root README. It covers where the training data comes from, why the mapper architectures are built the way they are (with paper citations and reasoning), how the pipeline versions differ, and how to point the same pipelines at a different dataset or a new architecture.
